title: Quantifying Feature Importance for Online Content Moderation
benchmark_measurement: The predictive power of user features, including a 'CULTURE' feature group that contains religious terms, on post-moderation user behavior (activity, toxicity, diversity).
findings: The feature subgroup 'CULTURE' from the LIWC lexicon, which includes terms related to religion, was not selected in the final predictive models for changes in user activity, toxicity, or diversity. This indicates it had limited predictive utility for post-moderation behavior compared to other features, despite showing some predictive power when evaluated in isolation.
